limitations: Only the 24 .wiff files are rows; the 24 .wiff.scan companions belong to the same acquisitions and are not separate data files (precedent in other QSTAR deposits).
Biological replicate numbering (110803 = 1, 110805 = 2) is inferred from file-name date order; no deposited mapping file exists.
Fraction numbers 1-6 come from the file-name suffixes; that they correspond to SCX fraction order is inferred, and the paper says only that phosphopeptide-containing SCX fractions were analysed.
Age 62Y and sex male are Cellosaurus values for HaCaT, not sample-level facts from the deposit.

Mascot parameters were read from one .dat header (110803 control); the other three .dat and the ProteinPilot/Paragon .xml files (iodoacetamide alkylation, phosphorylation emphasis) were not inspected. Paragon search used no listed Unimod set so is not encoded.
